title: nephelium rubrum
intro: Nephelium rubrum, commonly known as the rambutan tree, is a tropical fruit-bearing tree native to Southeast Asia. The rambutan tree is valued for its fruit, which has been reported to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the rambutan fruit include supporting cardiovascular health, reducing stress and anxiety, and aiding in digestion. The bioactive constituents of the rambutan fruit include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
